answer.evidence: The tree is a rounded canopy blob on a short trunk. The silhouette widens from 3 px at row 5 to about 60 px at rows 27-29, then narrows to 9 px at the trunk (rows 70-73). The upper rows 5-17 are bright highlight clusters that read as the sunlit top of the dome. Below them the canopy shades from mid-green to near-black at rows 58-68, so the front and underside read as a volume. No hard front-edge line exists, as expected for foliage.
